changelog: Removed direct restatements of frozen output-format constraints from other sections so that [Output Rules] remains the sole place for those details.

Added concise guidance in [When to Segment] to discourage cuts that split multiword names, possessives/heads, adjective–head pairs, ambiguous nouns, classifier/affected predicates, and connective attachments.
Merged the candidate_rules into [Priority Rules] as an explicit list of high-risk patterns with prescribed low-score ranges so risky splits are still marked but deprioritised.
Tweaked [Decision Procedure] to reference the high-risk scoring guidance during the scoring pass and to avoid repeating [Output Rules] specifics while keeping the two-pass workflow.
Kept all other existing segmentation principles and examples unchanged to preserve prior behaviour while implementing the critic's measured fixes.
